name: smwmusic-rise-of-the-triad-how-it-feels-to-be-the-hunt-how-d-i-do-remix
title: Rise of the Triad - How it feels to be the HUNT ~ How'd I do? (Remix)
description:
It is some of the greatest video game music ever produced. Like, top five. Like, this shit is Symphony of the Night good, This is Mega Man X good. - CIVVIE 11, 2019

Did an arrangement of How'd I do? from Rise of the Triad. A song from another one of Lee Jackson's works that has become infamous now for being used in some FPS Youtuber's end-credits w/ most of his videos!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
3. E Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
